interface.optionalOutput: --output <new immutable phase evidence/execute JSON path>; default harness-adjudication.json.
interface.prerequisite: Root invocation only after final full source-bound integration PASS. No automatic invocation or build/runtime retry.
interface.stdout: Only fixed status/category or receipt path/SHA256 plus actual case/target/negative counts; no raw errors/bodies/credentials.

exitCodes.0: Complete matching evidence adjudicated; actual integration/component observations and assertions checked.
exitCodes.2: Unavailable, stale, invalid or incomplete evidence/input.

evidenceContract.integration: Standard schema-validated kind aggregate stage integration PASS; exact final config/source/package/profile/seal bindings, all current components/scenarios observed and passed.
evidenceContract.chain: Aggregate execution refs uniquely match every component. Execution and component receipts hashed, schema-validated, binding-compatible and clean. Paired package refusal components may validly have nonzero exits; harness/UAR require actual exit0.
evidenceContract.harness: Exact 13 main cases plus 5 kernel cases from real private main/kernel receipt refs; exact18/5 counts, nonzero physical model calls, model request classes total matches, unknown0, six independently expected permitted effect markers exactly once, native wake profile fields, actual supervised-sidecar coverage marker.
evidenceContract.regression: Exactly five command-selected targets server-full,test-probes and 15 exact named negatives; each H scenario case/negative count agrees with its configured exact mapping, actual adapter target/summary/positive/negative counts and cleanup observed.
evidenceContract.correlation: Original admission/run/epoch/cursor before/after data are assertion-backed inside the actually executed matching gate. They are not persisted fields; no IDs/counters are fabricated. Exact retry supplemental cursor case remains named actual supporting negative.
evidenceContract.cleanup: Actual process exit/category and owned group absence/unknownDescendants=false plus component descendantsReconciled/remaining0; no assumption from pre-finally success marker.
evidenceContract.sourceScopes: Only explicitly listed current eligible assertion sources rehashed: harness gate/runtime/peer/supervisor/native, kernel harness test, UAR cursor test and phase adapters. Full component source path/binding metadata is retained without repository traversal.

expectedInventory.disposition: These are expectations to compare against actual future committed evidence, not observed results.

proofLimitations: Bossfang harness -> private application-equivalent fixture supervisor -> actual packaged sidecar. Native direct Bossfang principal transport is not certified.
Local fixture host-session identity is distinct from supporting configured standalone JWT/JWKS/tenant checks. No original caller JWT forwarding or named production receiver/IdP/custody claim.
Supporting server-full,test-probes targets differ from packaged server-full sidecar; packaged desktop startup is a separate actual component.
Actual restart is unsupported/unknown and requires reconciliation. No durable recovery/replay/external exactly-once guarantee.
Per-target summary rows/test-name transcripts and original run/cursor snapshots are not persisted by existing adapters. Successful matching adapter/gate assertions are explicitly identified as such.
Unsigned local darwin-arm64 only; wider platform/signing/installation/publication/remote release authority remains outside this adjudication.

sources.section: Gate output contract and coordinator adjudication

noDuplicate: Finite phase/evidence/dispatch file inventory contained no existing harness adjudication implementation; this is a new receipt-only task implementation, reusing existing component binding and receipt validation helpers.
handoff: Add this driver/readiness to explicit preparation/diagnostic metadata as appropriate. Root invokes after actual completed integration. Driver writes no expectation-only PASS and makes no delivery/canonical completion transition.
